title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under the influence of peers, policies, media messaging, and mask availability.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Persons observe mask use among their network neighbors or co-located peers and update adoption intentions based on conformity and observed prevalence.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations with mandates require mask usage; persons decide to comply based on perceived penalty, enforcement strength, and personal traits.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Information channels broadcast messages affecting risk perception and trust; effects scaled by channel credibility and individual trust_in_authority.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Persons buy masks from retailers subject to stock and price; purchase likelihood depends on price_sensitivity, income, and adoption_intent.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Persons visit locations following daily schedules, creating opportunities for norm observation, enforcement, and information exchange.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Share of persons wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_after_policy
metrics.description: Average adoption during the 14 days following mandate end.

metrics.name: location_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Mean fraction of masked entrants at mandate-enforced locations.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Proportion of retailer-days with zero mask stock.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Variance or Gini coefficient of adoption across groups.

metrics.name: penalty_events_per_capita
metrics.description: Average number of enforcement penalties issued per person.

metrics.name: message_reach
metrics.description: Fraction of persons exposed to at least one information message per day.
